process.title: Jobs a mid-level frontend developer could apply for
process.task: Frontend or full-stack roles, remote or in Amsterdam, not senior or lead positions, for a mid-level frontend developer.

steps.question: What kind of development work is this job mainly about?

options.name: frontend
options.meaning: mainly building user interfaces or web frontends, such as React, Vue, CSS or design-system components

options.name: full-stack
options.meaning: real work on both the frontend and the backend or API behind it

options.name: other
options.meaning: mainly backend, infrastructure, mobile, data or other work, where frontend is at most a small side task

then.target: not sure whether this is a frontend or full-stack role

steps.question: Where would someone in this job have to work?

options.name: amsterdam
options.meaning: in an office in Amsterdam, fully or hybrid

options.name: remote-open
options.meaning: remote, and someone living in the Netherlands can do it (e.g. Europe, EU time zones, the Netherlands, or worldwide), with at most rare office visits

options.name: remote-restricted
options.meaning: remote, but only for people living in or working the hours of another region, such as US residents only

options.name: elsewhere
options.meaning: in an office in another city than Amsterdam, on-site or hybrid

then.target: not sure whether the location works (remote or Amsterdam)

steps.question: At what seniority level is this job hiring?

options.name: junior
options.meaning: a junior, starter, trainee or intern position

options.name: mid
options.meaning: a mid-level or medior position, e.g. asking for about 2 to 5 years of experience

options.name: senior-lead
options.meaning: a senior, lead, principal or managing position, e.g. asking for 7+ years, setting technical direction, or leading people

options.name: unstated
options.meaning: the text gives no sign of the level

then.target: junior role: still worth applying as a mid-level developer?
not sure about the seniority level
